sources: Flare 2.0 新动作清单 2026-11-20（Google 表 1njBhCNMs-iliNbt3gKxDwCZnpQBxQoi-yPFRGQHmJwk，P1 追加：跪姿前臂拉伸（指尖朝膝））

purpose.zh: 拉开前臂内侧和手腕，撑地练习前后的放松
purpose.en: Stretches the inside of your forearms and wrists before and after support work.

text.zh: 手指朝膝盖，掌根压住地，臀部慢慢往后坐
text.en: Fingers toward your knees, heels of the hands down, slowly sit back

text.zh: 跪撑，手放在肩膀下面，手掌转过来让手指朝向膝盖。
text.en: On hands and knees, hands under your shoulders, turn your hands so the fingers point at your knees.
Elbows straight, elbow creases facing forward.

text.zh: 前臂里面有拉的感觉就停住，别弹。
text.en: Stop where you feel the stretch inside the forearm; no bouncing.

commonErrors.en: Letting the heels of the hands lift.
Sitting back too fast or too far.

cautions.zh: 手腕刺疼就少坐一点；有腕伤先问医生
cautions.en: If your wrist feels sharp pain, sit back less; check with a doctor if you have a wrist injury.

flare2.item: P1 追加：跪姿前臂拉伸（指尖朝膝）
flare2.camera: 右前方高机位（看得到手指朝膝和后坐幅度）
flare2.doseBrief: 追加说明：静止 30 秒；草稿 2 组 × 30 秒、休 15 秒
flare2.note: Animation (r1): fingers back 171.5 deg, shoulders sit 10.5 cm behind the hands, wrist extension 103 deg, elbows straight with the creases forward (humerus outward roll; elbow twist 1.3 deg). Not the same as forearms-A (dynamic four-direction wrist rocks).

set.zh: 手指朝膝盖，掌根压住地
set.en: Fingers to your knees, heels of the hands down

set.zh: 前臂里面有拉的感觉就够了，别弹
set.en: A gentle pull inside the forearm is enough, no bouncing
Elbows straight, elbow creases facing forward
